test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Arrange the following rivers as they occur from the North to South direction in India.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Indus, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Satluj.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indus, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Satluj** are rivers,** **occur in the North-South direction in India.
 
• **Jhelum and Ravi join Chenab, Beas joins Sutlej, and then Sutlej and Chenab** combine to form Panjnad 10 miles north of Uch Sharif in **Muzaffar Garh district. **
 
• The combined stream runs southwest for roughly **45 miles** and joins the **Indus River at Mithankot.**
 
• Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas and Sutlej are** branches of the Indus River.**
 
• The Chenab River is the **largest side stream of the river Indus.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Indus **is the most important distributor of water resources to the Punjab and Sindh plains.
 
• **​The river, Chenab** has rich power generation potential in India. ** **
 
• **Ravi river** rises in the Himalayas in Himachal Pradesh state, India.
 
• **The Beas River** is the place of India's eastern-most border, which marks Alexander the Great's conquests in 326 BC. 
 
• **Satluj **is the easternmost branch of the **Indus River. **
